name: stopped-boluses
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with boluses stopped part-way: 4.0 U delivered in full 240 minutes ago, 3.0 U stopped at 1.0 U 150 minutes ago (from an app), 2.5 U stopped at 1.8 U 60 minutes ago, and 2.0 U stopped 10 minutes ago before it delivered anything, the last bolus, so LastBolusStatus reads 0 U delivered. With Control-IQ off the pump shows about 2.7 U IOB.
